metadata.hypothesis_title: Thalamocortical Coupling Modulates White Matter Integrity in Insomnia

critic_findings.message: The use of Spearman correlation may not be the most appropriate method for analyzing the relationship between thalamus-DMN FC and FA in thalamic radiation, given the potential for linear relationships.
critic_findings.recommendation: Consider using linear regression as a primary analysis method to better capture the relationship between thalamus-DMN FC and FA, while controlling for covariates.

critic_findings.message: Missing DTI and EEG data may have limited the scope of the analysis and the ability to fully explore the relationship between thalamus-DMN FC and FA.
critic_findings.recommendation: Acquire DTI and EEG data to enhance the analysis and provide more comprehensive insights.
